outcome: identification of intrauterine growth restricted babies
detection of low birth weight newborn babies
cohort: A total of 254 small for gestational age (SGA) babies admitted in RL Jalappa Hospital, Tamaka, Karnataka, India, born between 28 weeks to 42 weeks of gestation.
finding: Mid arm circumference was found to be a better predictor of SGA babies and statistically superior to other anthropometric parameters (ponderal index, MAC/HC ratio) in detecting low birth weight newborn babies.
cross-section timing: At the time of admission to RL Jalappa Hospital
birth_weight: Low birth weight babies, normal birth weights, small for gestational age babies
